text: Chongqing Yufu Capital Operation Group Co., Ltd. (重庆渝富资本运营集团有限公司) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group Co., Ltd. (重庆渝富控股集团有限公司).
short: Yufu Capital is wholly owned by Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group.

source.name: 重庆市国有资产监督管理委员会 (Chongqing Municipal SASAC portal): 重庆渝富控股集团有限公司所属子公司总经理公开招聘公告
source.quote: 重庆渝富资本运营集团有限公司（以下简称“渝富资本”）为重庆渝富控股集团有限公司全资子公司
source.note: Translation: 'Chongqing Yufu Capital Operation Group Co., Ltd. (Yufu Capital) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group Co., Ltd.' Published in the recruitment column of the Chongqing Municipal SASAC's own portal; the notice also gives Yufu Capital's registered capital as RMB 10 billion.

additionalSources.name: 西南证券股份有限公司收购报告书 (Southwest Securities Co., Ltd. acquisition report), Shanghai Stock Exchange filing
additionalSources.quote: 本次股份划转的国有股份的划出方为划入方的全资子公司
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'The transferor of the state-owned shares in this share transfer is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the recipient.' The transferor is Yufu Capital and the recipient Yufu Holdings; the report's core-enterprise table also lists Yufu Capital at 100.00% under Yufu Holdings.
